traditional: the Sun opposition Jupiter: a hard contact. Vitality, authority, and recognition works against growth, fortune, and patronage - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas.
modern: Identity meets optimism, expansion, and luck. Confidence to venture and a sense that the odds will cooperate. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: The same confidence overreaches. Sooner or later the luck gets pushed too far. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Selfhood and growth reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Confidence and opportunity, with overextension as the standing risk.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center collides with excess and overreach; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: A larger opportunity can arrive with a workload that was easy to overlook while imagining everything the expansion would make possible.

readerCopy.body: A larger opportunity can arrive with a workload that was easy to overlook while imagining everything the expansion would make possible. When the Sun opposes Jupiter, confidence and growth face each other directly, making the benefits of a bigger role, audience, goal, or commitment easy to see before the cost reaches the calendar, budget, or existing responsibilities. More can be better without fitting automatically. The opportunity becomes easier to judge once the life required to carry it is counted too.
